findings.summary: _review_in_flight_phase excludes terminal phases but no test covers a complete, failed, queued or working review phase, so removing that exclusion or the queued/working half keeps all three cases green.

_review_run_in_flight is called without the pointers= the recogniser accepts, so query.project_live_rows (reckon/crew/query.py:887) re-lists the project's live pointers once per scoring row; passing the snapshot it already read would keep the live view linear.

review:
VERDICT goal: the goal is that a starting, queued or working review run counts as its subject's review in flight; the landed change reads the reflex's own recogniser (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:615 _review_run_in_flight) and the review run's own pointer phase (:643 _review_pointer_phase), so the subject's row carries review_run_id/review_run_phase and its next_action names that run.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks a new tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py to show a subject naming its starting review with no dispatch, the live view listing the starting run, and a subject with no review still printing the dispatch; the manifest records that file passing (head-arm.log "3 passed in 1.74s", EXIT=0 at 0a750cc551) and the importers unbroken (head-importers.log "135 passed", base-arm.log "132 passed"), so the gate asserts the measure.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py, reckon/crew/query.py, tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory (prompt.txt:78-82); every path in the diff at 7982557bec2d..0a750cc551 is one of the first four.
VERDICT manifest: read at .../r-20261102T215409121985-a-starting-review-is-visible/manifest.md; it reports status complete, two commits, the three gate logs plus the negative control, baseline_suite 132 passed and after_suite 3 passed, each with a log path.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit against base 7982557bec2d; 1f5536965f adds the recogniser call, the two row fields and the live vocabulary entries, 0a750cc551b0 splits the scoring detail so a dispatched review is not described as still owed one, and both stay inside the classifier, the field declaration and the test.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/query.py:887, reckon/crew/obligations.py:638, reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2159, reckon/crew/directory.py:97, reckon/crew/promotion.py:387, reckon/serve.py:899

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1427-1443 makes the scoring row carry the in-flight review's id and phase and replaces the dispatch with reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:661 _review_in_flight_action.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: head-arm.log records 3 passed EXIT=0 at 0a750cc551 and head-importers.log 135 passed, but the manifest's structured after_suite (manifest.md:22) carries only the three-test arm beside a sixteen-file baseline_suite (manifest.md:21), so the pair alone does not show the importer set unbroken and the negative control (negative-control.log:1) ran at 1f5536965f, one commit before the head.

SCORE durability: 15
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_starting_review_is_visible.py:95-101 fails when _review_run_in_flight returns ("", "") — negative-control.log shows both in-flight cases reddening — but no test exercises a terminal or queued review phase, so deleting the phase predicate at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:612 leaves the suite green.
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: the prose next_action matches the pre-existing hold action at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:1158 and the function-local read_pointer import matches reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:200.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change reuses the reflex's own recogniser _review_in_flight (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:527) rather than restating it, and feeds phase spellings from _PRE_SPAWN_PHASES; the only copy is a second per-row sweep the recogniser's pointers= argument exists to avoid.
FINDING reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:612 non-blocking: _review_in_flight_phase excludes terminal phases but no test covers a complete, failed, queued or working review phase, so removing that exclusion or the queued/working half keeps all three cases green.
